text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Narita Taishin and 
Tamamo Cross talking behind the school 
building.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What's up? Callin' me out to a place 
like this out of nowhere. I ain't got a 
clue what this is about...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Do you happen to know what Creek-san 
likes?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Stuff Creek likes? Nothin' really 
jumps out off the top of my head, but—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I seeee, you wanna talk about a present 
for her, huh. If that's it, she'd be 
thrilled with just about anything, ya 
know?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, I mean... that's true, but. Like... 
ugh...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What's with ya? Beat around the bush any 
more and you'll dig a hole... You got some 
kinda tricky situation goin' on?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well... I'm Creek-san's roommate, right? 
So, that's why—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Were my training socks always this 
comfortable to wear...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I thought it would be dangerous if 
they tore, so I patched them up during my 
break~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So keep doing your best with your 
training, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Y-You don't have to tell me... I was 
planning to anyway...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ah, Taishin-chan! Over here~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...What? I have a bunch of things I need 
to do.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. That's true. You're always 
working so hard in our room with muscle 
training, stretching, and all sorts of 
things, dear~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But to work even harder, you need plenty 
of energy! Which means—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da! Packed with nutrition! A special 
rice bowl guaranteed to fill you with 
stamina~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Right now is a ve~ry important time for me 
too. So I wanted us to do our best 
together, you see♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...I'm always on the receiving end. And... 
I hate being indebted to someone.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
But it's not like I want to just give her 
something half-assed. So...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Huh. In that case, I ain't got nothin' 
special to say. Seems like you already got 
your answer.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna repay the favor she gave ya, 
then just give her back the exact same 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Weeell, if you still don't get it, I could 
hold yer hand and walk ya through it, ya 
know~?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If I don't find the answer myself, it's 
meaningless. ...That's what you mean, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Bingo! Well, if you can be honest with 
yerself and admit that, you might find it 
pretty quick.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Honesty...

...Tama-cha~n? Where are you~? It's 
lunchtime, dear~

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh! Tama-chan, and... Taishin-chan?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, my? Such serious expressions... Are 
you troubled about something? If so, how 
about we talk over lunch—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Eh?! No, ...it's...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I-It's nothing big anyway. Just leave me 
alone...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Don't push yourself too hard, 
okay~?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Man, looks like this is gonna be 
a long battle.
